## Project Overview
ChronoSentiment — a chronology-based sentiment analysis system with a genetic algorithm (GA) optimization layer. The project has a React UI (`my-chrono-sentiment-ui`) and backend services. A comprehensive architectural governance audit was performed, producing `DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md` as a constitutional document.

## Completed Work
1. Reviewed full project structure and architecture
2. Collected and read all `.md` documentation files
3. Read all UI components (`App.js`, `GlobalRanking.js`, `CompareStrategies.js`, `RunGA.js`, `StrategyColumn.js`)
4. Cross-referenced documentation vs UI implementation — discovered not a feature gap but an ontological/architectural identity divergence
5. Generated `DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md` — 93+ discrepancies across 21 sections, structured as a constitutional governance artifact
6. Applied final diff to `DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md` adding the four-law constitutional preamble and five-layer authority hierarchy table to the document header
7. Received and acknowledged user's architectural reflection confirming the report's value as governance clarification rather than remediation checklist
8. Appended Section 22 — **The Concept Extraction Pathway** — to `DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md`, completing the document at 22 sections

## Key Technical Decisions
- **Root finding**: The UI did not have missing features — it had evolved around the wrong architectural center of gravity (Identity B: GA Optimization Dashboard) instead of the correct one (Identity A: Chronology Observability System)
- **Constitutional laws established** (4 laws): Law One through Law Four governing replay integrity, chronology truth, backend authority, and observer-only UI behavior
- **Five-layer authority hierarchy**: Kernel → Replay Engine → Schema Layer → API/Endpoint Layer → Observer UI — any component operating outside its layer is a constitutional violation
- **Reclassification over invalidation**: Current React UI work is reclassified as exploratory/prototype, not invalidated — valuable UX concepts (replay interaction, narrative sequencing, divergence visualization, causal chain UX, comparative forensic workflows) should be extracted and rebuilt inside observer-first architecture
- **Mandatory build sequencing**: 5 schemas → endpoints → observer UI → Law One audit (schema-driven, not UI-driven development)
- **Observer vs Analyst distinction**: UI must observe truth computed by backend, never synthesize or interpret truth client-side
- **Concept extraction table**: Each prototype UX discovery mapped to its correct observer-first reinterpretation in `services/ui`, with source file references

## Relevant Files & Code
- `DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md` — Constitutional governance document, **fully complete at 22 sections** (preamble + 4 laws + 5-layer hierarchy + 93+ discrepancies + concept extraction pathway). The authoritative artifact for all future UI and architecture decisions.
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/App.js` — Main React app, audited; classified as Identity B surface
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/GlobalRanking.js` — Audited; computes ranking client-side (constitutional violation)
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/CompareStrategies.js` — Audited; performs client-side interpretation (constitutional violation)
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/RunGA.js` — Audited; GA tooling became primary surface (product identity drift)
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/StrategyColumn.js` — Audited; part of analyst-pattern UI

## Current Status
All audit tasks are complete. `DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md` is finalized at 22 sections:

| Layer | Content |
|-------|---------|
| Preamble | 4 constitutional laws + 5-layer authority hierarchy |
| Sections 1–17 | 93+ technical discrepancies across all components |
| Section 18 | Architectural succession declaration |
| Section 19 | Strategic analysis and root cause |
| Section 20 | Build sequencing contract (5 schemas → endpoints → observer UI → Law One audit) |
| Section 21 | Governance summary |
| Section 22 | Concept extraction pathway (prototype → canonical reinterpretation) |

The transformation pathway is clearly defined:

| Old Mental Model | New Mental Model |
|---|---|
| Fix the existing UI | Extract concepts, rebuild architecture |
| Frontend feature parity | Observer-certified surfaces |
| React app with backend APIs | Chronology observability frontend |
| UI-driven workflows | Schema-driven observability |

## Pending Tasks
- No explicit new tasks assigned. The natural next phase (per Section 20 of the report) is: build the 5 canonical schemas → implement endpoints → rebuild observer UI → perform Law One audit. This has not yet been formally requested.
